+"""intraday_sim.py — CLI that wires yfinance intraday data → strategy → PaperEngine → CSV output."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import logging
+import math
+import sys
+from datetime import date
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pandas as pd
+import yfinance as yf
+
+from paper_trading_sim import metrics
+from strategies.engulfing import EngulfingStrategy
+from strategies.paper_engine import PaperEngine
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+STRATEGIES = {
+    "engulfing": EngulfingStrategy,
+}
+
+VALID_INTERVALS = {"1m", "5m", "15m", "30m", "60m"}
+
+
+def _parse_tickers(args: argparse.Namespace) -> list[str]:
+    if args.tickers_file:
+        path = Path(args.tickers_file)
+        if not path.exists():
+            logger.error("tickers_file not found: %s", path)
+            sys.exit(1)
+        tickers = [line.strip() for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    elif args.tickers:
+        tickers = [t.strip() for t in args.tickers.split(",") if t.strip()]
+    else:
+        logger.error("Provide --tickers or --tickers_file.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    return tickers
+
+
+def _run_ticker(
+    ticker: str,
+    start: str,
+    end: str,
+    interval: str,
+    position_dollars: float,
+    stop_loss_pct: float,
+    take_profit_pct: float,
+    allow_short: bool,
+    strategy_cls,
+) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.Series]:
+    """Download data for one ticker and run the paper engine. Returns (trade_log, equity_curve)."""
+    df = yf.download(ticker, start=start, end=end, interval=interval, auto_adjust=True, progress=False)
+
+    if df.empty:
+        logger.warning("No data returned for %s — skipping.", ticker)
+        return pd.DataFrame(
+            columns=["open_time", "close_time", "direction", "entry_price", "exit_price", "pnl_dollars", "exit_reason"]
+        ), pd.Series(dtype=float)
+
+    # yfinance may return a MultiIndex if auto_adjust produces extra columns; flatten if needed
+    if isinstance(df.columns, pd.MultiIndex):
+        df.columns = df.columns.get_level_values(0)
+
+    strategy = strategy_cls()
+    engine = PaperEngine(strategy, position_dollars, stop_loss_pct, take_profit_pct, allow_short)
+    trade_log, equity_curve = engine.run(df)
+
+    # Tag each row with the ticker for multi-ticker aggregation
+    if not trade_log.empty:
+        trade_log.insert(0, "ticker", ticker)
+    if not equity_curve.empty:
+        equity_curve.name = ticker
+
+    return trade_log, equity_curve
+
+
+def _sharpe_of_daily_pnl(equity_curve: pd.Series) -> float:
+    """Compute Sharpe from daily P&L extracted from the combined equity curve."""
+    if equity_curve.empty:
+        return 0.0
+    # equity_curve is cumulative pnl indexed by timestamp; group by date, take last value per day
+    daily_pnl = equity_curve.groupby(equity_curve.index.date).last().diff().dropna()
+    if daily_pnl.empty or daily_pnl.std() == 0:
+        return 0.0
+    return (daily_pnl.mean() / daily_pnl.std()) * math.sqrt(252)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s: %(message)s")
+
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Intraday candlestick strategy paper backtest")
+    ticker_grp = p.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
+    ticker_grp.add_argument("--tickers", type=str, help="Comma-separated ticker symbols, e.g. AAPL,MSFT")
+    ticker_grp.add_argument("--tickers_file", type=str, help="Path to file with one ticker per line")
+
+    p.add_argument(
+        "--interval",
+        type=str,
+        default="5m",
+        choices=sorted(VALID_INTERVALS),
+        help="Bar interval (default: 5m). Note: 1m is limited to the last 7 days by yfinance.",
+    )
+    p.add_argument("--start", type=str, required=True, help="Start date YYYY-MM-DD")
+    p.add_argument("--end", type=str, default=None, help="End date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)")
+    p.add_argument("--strategy", type=str, default="engulfing", choices=list(STRATEGIES), help="Strategy name")
+    p.add_argument("--position_dollars", type=float, default=1000.0, help="Dollars per trade (default: 1000)")
+    p.add_argument("--stop_loss_pct", type=float, default=0.005, help="Stop-loss fraction (default: 0.005)")
+    p.add_argument("--take_profit_pct", type=float, default=0.01, help="Take-profit fraction (default: 0.01)")
+    p.add_argument("--no_short", action="store_true", help="Disable short selling")
+    p.add_argument("--out_csv", type=str, default="equity.csv", help="Equity curve output CSV (default: equity.csv)")
+    p.add_argument("--trades_csv", type=str, default="trades.csv", help="Trade log output CSV (default: trades.csv)")
+
+    args = p.parse_args()
+
+    if args.interval == "1m":
+        logger.warning(
+            "interval=1m: yfinance limits 1-minute data to the last 7 days. "
+            "Bars outside that window will be empty."
+        )
+
+    end = args.end or str(date.today())
+    tickers = _parse_tickers(args)
+    strategy_cls = STRATEGIES[args.strategy]
+    allow_short = not args.no_short
+
+    all_trades: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
+    all_equity: list[pd.Series] = []
+
+    for ticker in tickers:
+        logger.info("Processing %s ...", ticker)
+        trade_log, equity_curve = _run_ticker(
+            ticker,
+            args.start,
+            end,
+            args.interval,
+            args.position_dollars,
+            args.stop_loss_pct,
+            args.take_profit_pct,
+            allow_short,
+            strategy_cls,
+        )
+        if not trade_log.empty:
+            all_trades.append(trade_log)
+        if not equity_curve.empty:
+            all_equity.append(equity_curve)
+
+    # Combine and write outputs
+    if all_trades:
+        combined_trades = pd.concat(all_trades, ignore_index=True)
+    else:
+        combined_trades = pd.DataFrame(
+            columns=["ticker", "open_time", "close_time", "direction", "entry_price", "exit_price", "pnl_dollars", "exit_reason"]
+        )
+
+    if all_equity:
+        combined_equity = pd.concat(all_equity).sort_index()
+    else:
+        combined_equity = pd.Series(dtype=float, name="pnl_dollars")
+
+    combined_trades.to_csv(args.trades_csv, index=False)
+    logger.info("Trades written to %s", args.trades_csv)
+
+    combined_equity.to_csv(args.out_csv, header=True)
+    logger.info("Equity curve written to %s", args.out_csv)
+
+    # Summary
+    total_trades = len(combined_trades)
+    if total_trades > 0:
+        wins = (combined_trades["pnl_dollars"] > 0).sum()
+        win_rate = wins / total_trades
+        total_pnl = combined_trades["pnl_dollars"].sum()
+    else:
+        win_rate = 0.0
+        total_pnl = 0.0
+
+    sharpe = _sharpe_of_daily_pnl(combined_equity)
+
+    print("\n=== Intraday Sim Summary ===")
+    print(f"Strategy      : {args.strategy}")
+    print(f"Tickers       : {', '.join(tickers)}")
+    print(f"Period        : {args.start} -> {end}  interval={args.interval}")
+    print(f"Total trades  : {total_trades}")
+    print(f"Win rate      : {win_rate:.1%}")
+    print(f"Total P&L     : ${total_pnl:,.2f}")
+    print(f"Daily Sharpe  : {sharpe:.3f}")
+    print(f"Equity CSV    : {args.out_csv}")
+    print(f"Trades CSV    : {args.trades_csv}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# mac-setup.sh — check prerequisites, start FastAPI server + ngrok tunnel,
+# print the public URL, and clean up both processes on Ctrl-C.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# ── Prerequisite checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+# Python >= 3.12
+if ! python3 --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "3\.(1[2-9]|[2-9][0-9])"; then
+    echo "ERROR: Python 3.12+ is required."
+    echo "  Install from https://www.python.org/downloads/ or via Homebrew:"
+    echo "  brew install python@3.12"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# uv
+if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "ERROR: uv is not installed."
+    echo "  Install uv: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# ngrok
+if ! command -v ngrok >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "ERROR: ngrok is not installed."
+    echo "  Install ngrok: brew install ngrok/ngrok/ngrok"
+    echo "  OR download from: https://ngrok.com/download"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Port 8000
+if lsof -ti:8000 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    PID_ON_PORT=$(lsof -ti:8000)
+    echo "ERROR: Port 8000 is already in use by PID ${PID_ON_PORT}."
+    echo "  Run: kill ${PID_ON_PORT}   then retry."
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Optional .env file
+if [ -f .env ]; then
+    # shellcheck disable=SC1091
+    source .env
+fi
+if [ -z "${WEB_AUTH_USER:-}" ]; then
+    echo "WARNING: WEB_AUTH_USER not set — server will start without authentication."
+fi
+
+# ── Install Python dependencies ────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+echo "Installing dependencies..."
+uv sync --quiet 2>/dev/null || pip install -e . -q
+
+# ── Start FastAPI server in background ────────────────────────────────────────
+
+echo "Starting FastAPI server on http://127.0.0.1:8000 ..."
+uv run uvicorn webapp.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 &
+SERVER_PID=$!
+
+# Wait up to 5 s for port 8000 to accept connections
+READY=0
+for i in $(seq 1 10); do
+    if nc -z 127.0.0.1 8000 2>/dev/null; then
+        READY=1
+        break
+    fi
+    sleep 0.5
+done
+
+if [ "$READY" -eq 0 ]; then
+    echo "ERROR: FastAPI server did not start within 5 seconds."
+    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# ── Start ngrok tunnel in background ──────────────────────────────────────────
+
+echo "Starting ngrok tunnel..."
+ngrok http 8000 --log=stdout >/tmp/ngrok.log 2>&1 &
+NGROK_PID=$!
+
+# Poll ngrok local API for the public URL (up to 10 s)
+PUBLIC_URL=""
+for i in $(seq 1 20); do
+    PUBLIC_URL=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels 2>/dev/null \
+        | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['tunnels'][0]['public_url'])" \
+        2>/dev/null || true)
+    if [ -n "$PUBLIC_URL" ]; then
+        break
+    fi
+    sleep 0.5
+done
+
+if [ -z "$PUBLIC_URL" ]; then
+    echo "ERROR: ngrok tunnel did not start. Check /tmp/ngrok.log for details."
+    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+    kill "$NGROK_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# ── Print success ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+echo ""
+echo "✅  Server: http://127.0.0.1:8000"
+echo "🌐  Public: ${PUBLIC_URL}"
+echo "📱  Open the public URL on your iPhone, then tap Share → Add to Home Screen"
+echo ""
+echo "Press Ctrl-C to stop."
+
+# ── Trap SIGINT for clean shutdown ────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+trap 'echo ""; echo "Stopping..."; kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; kill "$NGROK_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 0' INT
+
+# Keep script alive until Ctrl-C
+wait "$SERVER_PID"

+"""Generate PWA app icon PNGs for the trading webapp.
+
+Draws a candlestick chart motif on a dark navy background and exports three
+sizes: 180×180 (iOS apple-touch-icon), 192×192, and 512×512 (PWA manifest).
+
+Usage:
+    python3 scripts/generate_icons.py
+"""
+
+import io
+import pathlib
+
+import matplotlib
+matplotlib.use("Agg")
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import matplotlib.patches as patches
+
+OUTPUT_DIR = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent.parent / "webapp" / "static" / "icons"
+
+BG_COLOR = "#111b2b"
+FG_COLOR = "#ffffff"
+TEAL = "#2fd4c4"
+RED = "#e05c5c"
+GREEN = "#4caf82"
+
+SIZES = [
+    ("icon-180.png", 180),
+    ("icon-192.png", 192),
+    ("icon-512.png", 512),
+]
+
+
+def draw_icon(size_px: int) -> bytes:
+    """Return PNG bytes for the icon at the given pixel size."""
+    dpi = 100
+    fig_size = size_px / dpi
+
+    fig = plt.Figure(figsize=(fig_size, fig_size), dpi=dpi)
+    ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
+    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
+    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
+    ax.set_aspect("equal")
+    ax.axis("off")
+    ax.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
+    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
+
+    pad = 0.12
+    chart_left = pad
+    chart_right = 1 - pad
+    chart_bottom = pad + 0.08
+    chart_top = 1 - pad
+
+    # Three candlestick bars: red, red, green (engulfing)
+    bars = [
+        # (center_x, open_y, close_y, high_y, low_y, color)
+        (0.28, 0.65, 0.50, 0.70, 0.45, RED),
+        (0.50, 0.60, 0.45, 0.65, 0.40, RED),
+        (0.72, 0.38, 0.72, 0.78, 0.33, GREEN),
+    ]
+
+    bar_half_width = 0.09
+
+    for cx, open_y, close_y, high_y, low_y, color in bars:
+        body_bottom = min(open_y, close_y)
+        body_height = abs(close_y - open_y)
+
+        # Wick (thin line through full high-low range)
+        ax.plot(
+            [cx, cx],
+            [low_y, high_y],
+            color=color,
+            linewidth=max(1, size_px / 128),
+            solid_capstyle="round",
+        )
+
+        # Body (filled rectangle)
+        body = patches.FancyBboxPatch(
+            (cx - bar_half_width, body_bottom),
+            bar_half_width * 2,
+            body_height,
+            boxstyle="square,pad=0",
+            linewidth=0,
+            facecolor=color,
+        )
+        ax.add_patch(body)
+
+    # Teal accent underline
+    ax.plot(
+        [chart_left, chart_right],
+        [chart_bottom, chart_bottom],
+        color=TEAL,
+        linewidth=max(2, size_px / 80),
+        solid_capstyle="round",
+    )
+
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=dpi, facecolor=BG_COLOR)
+    plt.close(fig)
+    buf.seek(0)
+    return buf.read()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for filename, size in SIZES:
+        out_path = OUTPUT_DIR / filename
+        png_bytes = draw_icon(size)
+        out_path.write_bytes(png_bytes)
+        print(f"  wrote {out_path} ({size}×{size})")
+    print("Done.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Morning runner — orchestrates the daily trade pipeline.
+
+Steps:
+1. Download latest OHLCV data via fetch_history
+2. Optionally retrain the GBM model based on --retrain schedule
+3. Run prediction → write next_alloc.csv
+4. Run Robinhood executor (dry-run by default)
+
+Usage examples:
+    uv run morning-runner --tickers_file tickers/sp500.txt
+    uv run morning-runner --tickers AAPL,MSFT,NVDA --retrain weekly
+    uv run morning-runner --tickers_file tickers/sp500.txt --no_dry_run
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import glob
+import logging
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+from datetime import date, datetime
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+import joblib
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+# ── project imports ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+from paper_trading_sim import (
+    build_feature_panel,
+    build_features,
+    fetch_history,
+    prepare_xy,
+    train_model,
+)
+from predict_next import (
+    compute_returns,
+    fetch_latest_frames,
+    meanvar_long_only,
+    parse_tickers,
+)
+
+
+# ── logging setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def setup_logging(log_dir: str) -> None:
+    """Configure logging to both console and a dated file in log_dir."""
+    os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
+    log_file = os.path.join(log_dir, f"morning_{date_str}.log")
+
+    fmt = "%(asctime)s  %(levelname)-8s  %(message)s"
+    logging.basicConfig(
+        level=logging.INFO,
+        format=fmt,
+        handlers=[
+            logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout),
+            logging.FileHandler(log_file),
+        ],
+    )
+    logging.getLogger(__name__).info("Logging to %s", log_file)
+
+
+# ── model helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def find_latest_model(models_dir: str = "models") -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return path to the most recently modified .joblib file, or None."""
+    bundles = glob.glob(os.path.join(models_dir, "*.joblib"))
+    if not bundles:
+        return None
+    return max(bundles, key=os.path.getmtime)
+
+
+def should_retrain(retrain: str, latest_model: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+    """Return True if the pipeline should retrain the model now."""
+    if retrain == "never":
+        return False
+    if latest_model is None:
+        return True  # no existing model — must train
+    age_days = (datetime.now().timestamp() - os.path.getmtime(latest_model)) / 86400.0
+    if retrain == "weekly":
+        return age_days >= 7
+    if retrain == "monthly":
+        return age_days >= 30
+    return False
+
+
+# ── pipeline steps ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def step_retrain(tickers: List[str], models_dir: str = "models") -> str:
+    """Retrain GBM on 5 years of data and save bundle to models/.
+
+    Returns:
+        Absolute path to the saved .joblib bundle.
+    """
+    log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+    log.info("Retraining model on %d tickers ...", len(tickers))
+
+    start = date.today().replace(year=date.today().year - 5).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

+import pandas as pd
+
+from strategies.base import BaseStrategy, Signal
+
+DOJI_THRESHOLD = 0.0005
+
+
+def _is_doji(bar: pd.Series) -> bool:
+    return abs(bar["Close"] - bar["Open"]) < DOJI_THRESHOLD * bar["Close"]
+
+
+class EngulfingStrategy(BaseStrategy):
+    def generate_signal(self, prev: pd.Series, curr: pd.Series, bar_index: int = 0) -> Signal:
+        if _is_doji(prev) or _is_doji(curr):
+            return Signal("HOLD", curr["Close"], bar_index)
+
+        prev_red = prev["Open"] > prev["Close"]
+        curr_green = curr["Close"] > curr["Open"]
+
+        if prev_red and curr_green:
+            if curr["Open"] <= prev["Close"] and curr["Close"] >= prev["Open"]:
+                return Signal("BUY", curr["Close"], bar_index)
+
+        prev_green = prev["Open"] < prev["Close"]
+        curr_red = curr["Close"] < curr["Open"]
+
+        if prev_green and curr_red:
+            if curr["Open"] >= prev["Close"] and curr["Close"] <= prev["Open"]:
+                return Signal("SELL", curr["Close"], bar_index)
+
+        return Signal("HOLD", curr["Close"], bar_index)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pandas as pd
+
+from strategies.base import BaseStrategy
+
+
+class PaperEngine:
+    """Bar-by-bar intraday paper trading engine.
+
+    Entry rule: signal fires on bar N -> position opens at bar N+1's Open.
+    Exit rules (checked in order each subsequent bar):
+      - Stop-loss wins over take-profit when both trigger on the same bar.
+      - EOD force-close: last bar of each calendar day closes any open position.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        strategy: BaseStrategy,
+        position_dollars: float = 1000.0,
+        stop_loss_pct: float = 0.005,
+        take_profit_pct: float = 0.01,
+        allow_short: bool = True,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.strategy = strategy
+        self.position_dollars = position_dollars
+        self.stop_loss_pct = stop_loss_pct
+        self.take_profit_pct = take_profit_pct
+        self.allow_short = allow_short
+
+    def run(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.Series]:
+        """Replay bars and return (trade_log, equity_curve)."""
+        trades: list[dict] = []
+
+        in_position = False
+        direction: str | None = None
+        entry_price: float = 0.0
+        entry_time: pd.Timestamp | None = None
+        stop_price: float = 0.0
+        take_profit_price: float = 0.0
+
+        # pending_direction: open a position on the *next* bar's Open
+        pending_direction: str | None = None
+
+        # Determine last bar of each calendar day for EOD close detection
+        dates = df.index.date
+        date_groups: dict = {}
+        for ts, d in zip(df.index, dates):
+            date_groups.setdefault(d, []).append(ts)
+        last_bar_of_day: set = {tss[-1] for tss in date_groups.values()}
+
+        bars = list(df.iterrows())  # [(timestamp, Series), ...]
+
+        for i, (ts, bar) in enumerate(bars):
+            # 1. Open pending position at this bar's Open
+            if pending_direction is not None and not in_position:
+                direction = pending_direction
+                pending_direction = None
+                entry_price = bar["Open"]
+                entry_time = ts
+                in_position = True
+
+                if direction == "LONG":
+                    stop_price = entry_price * (1.0 - self.stop_loss_pct)
+                    take_profit_price = entry_price * (1.0 + self.take_profit_pct)
+                else:  # SHORT
+                    stop_price = entry_price * (1.0 + self.stop_loss_pct)
+                    take_profit_price = entry_price * (1.0 - self.take_profit_pct)
+
+            # 2. Check exit conditions for open position
+            if in_position:
+                sl_hit = False
+                tp_hit = False
+                exit_price = 0.0
+                exit_reason = ""
+
+                if direction == "LONG":
+                    sl_hit = bar["Low"] <= stop_price
+                    tp_hit = bar["High"] >= take_profit_price
+                else:  # SHORT
+                    sl_hit = bar["High"] >= stop_price
+                    tp_hit = bar["Low"] <= take_profit_price
+
+                if sl_hit:
+                    exit_price = stop_price
+                    exit_reason = "stop_loss"
+                elif tp_hit:
+                    exit_price = take_profit_price
+                    exit_reason = "take_profit"
+
+                # EOD force-close on last bar of session (only if not already exiting)
+                if ts in last_bar_of_day and exit_reason == "":
+                    exit_price = bar["Close"]
+                    exit_reason = "eod_close"
+
+                if exit_reason:
+                    if direction == "LONG":
+                        pnl = (exit_price - entry_price) / entry_price * self.position_dollars
+                    else:
+                        pnl = (entry_price - exit_price) / entry_price * self.position_dollars
+
+                    trades.append(
+                        {
+                            "open_time": entry_time,
+                            "close_time": ts,
+                            "direction": "LONG" if direction == "LONG" else "SHORT",
+                            "entry_price": entry_price,
+                            "exit_price": exit_price,
+                            "pnl_dollars": pnl,
+                            "exit_reason": exit_reason,
+                        }
+                    )
+                    in_position = False
+                    direction = None
+
+            # 3. Generate signal for next bar (needs a previous bar; skip if in position)
+            if i > 0 and not in_position and pending_direction is None:
+                prev_ts, prev_bar = bars[i - 1]
+                signal = self.strategy.generate_signal(prev_bar, bar, bar_index=i)
+
+                if signal.direction == "BUY":
+                    pending_direction = "LONG"
+                elif signal.direction == "SELL" and self.allow_short:
+                    pending_direction = "SHORT"
+
+        # Build outputs
+        if trades:
+            trade_log = pd.DataFrame(trades)
+        else:
+            trade_log = pd.DataFrame(
+                columns=[
+                    "open_time",
+                    "close_time",
+                    "direction",
+                    "entry_price",
+                    "exit_price",
+                    "pnl_dollars",
+                    "exit_reason",
+                ]
+            )
+
+        if not trade_log.empty:
+            equity_curve = trade_log.set_index("close_time")["pnl_dollars"].cumsum()
+        else:
+            equity_curve = pd.Series(dtype=float, name="pnl_dollars")
+
+        return trade_log, equity_curve

+"""Unit tests for meanvar_long_only and meanvar_long_short allocation functions."""
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+from walkforward_sim import meanvar_long_only, meanvar_long_short
+
+
+def _simple_sigma(n: int = 3) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Return a simple diagonal covariance matrix."""
+    return np.diag([0.01, 0.01, 0.01][:n])
+
+
+# mu vector where the raw Σ^{-1}μ weights (proportional to mu for diagonal Σ)
+# sum to a positive number so no fallback is triggered, yet one entry is negative.
+# Chosen so sum(mu) > 0: 0.08 + (-0.02) + 0.03 = 0.09
+_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE = np.array([0.08, -0.02, 0.03])
+
+
+class TestMeanvarLongOnly:
+    def test_all_weights_nonneg_with_negative_mu(self):
+        """Long-only should clip negatives; all weights >= 0 even when mu has a negative entry."""
+        w = meanvar_long_only(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert np.all(w >= 0.0), f"Expected all weights >= 0, got {w}"
+
+    def test_negative_mu_asset_gets_zero_weight(self):
+        """The asset with negative mu must receive exactly 0 weight (clamped)."""
+        w = meanvar_long_only(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert w[1] == 0.0, f"Negative-mu asset must be clamped to 0, got w[1]={w[1]}"
+
+    def test_weights_sum_to_one(self):
+        mu = np.array([0.05, 0.03, 0.02])
+        w = meanvar_long_only(mu, _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert abs(w.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-9, f"Weights should sum to 1, got {w.sum()}"
+
+    def test_all_negative_mu_falls_back_to_equal(self):
+        """When all predicted returns are negative the fallback produces equal weights."""
+        mu = np.array([-0.05, -0.03, -0.02])
+        w = meanvar_long_only(mu, _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert np.all(w >= 0.0)
+        assert abs(w.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-9
+
+    def test_max_w_cap_respected(self):
+        """The per-asset cap must be enforced."""
+        # Use a dominant asset that would exceed the cap without clamping.
+        # With diagonal Sigma raw weights ∝ mu; 0.5/(0.5+0.1+0.1)≈0.71 > 0.5 cap.
+        mu = np.array([0.50, 0.10, 0.10])
+        w = meanvar_long_only(mu, _simple_sigma(3), max_w=0.5)
+        assert np.all(w <= 0.5 + 1e-9), f"Max weight violated: {w}"
+
+
+class TestMeanvarLongShort:
+    def test_negative_mu_produces_negative_weight(self):
+        """When one asset has a negative predicted return, its weight should be negative."""
+        w = meanvar_long_short(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert w[1] < 0.0, f"Expected negative weight for negative-mu entry, got {w}"
+
+    def test_long_only_same_mu_all_nonneg(self):
+        """Confirm long-only variant gives >= 0 for the same input where long-short gives negative."""
+        w_lo = meanvar_long_only(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert np.all(w_lo >= 0.0), f"Long-only should produce no negatives, got {w_lo}"
+
+    def test_weights_sum_to_one(self):
+        w = meanvar_long_short(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert abs(w.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-9, f"Weights should sum to 1, got {w.sum()}"
+
+    def test_positive_mu_all_weights_nonneg(self):
+        """With all positive mu both allocators should give all positive weights."""
+        mu = np.array([0.05, 0.03, 0.02])
+        w_ls = meanvar_long_short(mu, _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert np.all(w_ls >= 0.0), f"All-positive mu should give non-negative weights, got {w_ls}"
+
+    def test_meanvar_long_only_not_modified(self):
+        """Regression guard: meanvar_long_only must still clamp negative raw weights to 0."""
+        w_lo = meanvar_long_only(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        w_ls = meanvar_long_short(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        # long-only never has negative weights; long-short does for this input
+        assert np.all(w_lo >= 0.0), "meanvar_long_only must not allow negative weights"
+        assert np.any(w_ls < 0.0), "meanvar_long_short must allow negative weights"

+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def make_bars(rows):
+    """rows: list of (timestamp_str, open, high, low, close)."""
+    idx = pd.DatetimeIndex([pd.Timestamp(r[0]) for r in rows])
+    return pd.DataFrame(
+        {
+            "Open": [r[1] for r in rows],
+            "High": [r[2] for r in rows],
+            "Low": [r[3] for r in rows],
+            "Close": [r[4] for r in rows],
+            "Volume": [1000] * len(rows),
+        },
+        index=idx,
+    )
+
+
+class MockStrategy(BaseStrategy):
+    """Returns a pre-scripted sequence of signals by bar_index."""
+
+    def __init__(self, signals: dict[int, str]):
+        # signals maps bar_index -> direction ("BUY" / "SELL" / "HOLD")
+        self._signals = signals
+
+    def generate_signal(self, prev: pd.Series, curr: pd.Series, bar_index: int = 0) -> Signal:
+        direction = self._signals.get(bar_index, "HOLD")
+        return Signal(direction=direction, price=curr["Close"], bar_index=bar_index)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Test 1: BUY signal fires -> position opens at NEXT bar's Open
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def test_entry_at_next_bar_open():
+    """Signal on bar 1 (index=1) -> entry at bar 2's Open, not bar 1's Close."""
+    bars = make_bars([
+        ("2024-01-02 09:30:00", 100, 101, 99, 100),   # bar 0
+        ("2024-01-02 09:31:00", 100, 105, 99, 104),   # bar 1 — signal fires (bar_index=1)
+        ("2024-01-02 09:32:00", 102, 115, 101.6, 114),  # bar 2 — entry at Open=102; SL=101.49, TP=103.02; Low=101.6>SL, High=115->TP hit
+    ])
+    # Signal fires at bar_index=1; position opens at bar 2's Open (102)
+    strategy = MockStrategy({1: "BUY"})
+    engine = PaperEngine(strategy, position_dollars=1000.0, stop_loss_pct=0.005, take_profit_pct=0.01)
+    trade_log, _ = engine.run(bars)

+    assert len(trade_log) == 1
+    assert trade_log.iloc[0]["entry_price"] == pytest.approx(102.0)

+    strategy = MockStrategy({1: "SELL"})

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# mac-setup.sh — check prerequisites, start FastAPI server + ngrok tunnel,
+# print the public URL, and clean up both processes on Ctrl-C.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# ── Prerequisite checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+# Python >= 3.12
+if ! python3 --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "3\.(1[2-9]|[2-9][0-9])"; then
+    echo "ERROR: Python 3.12+ is required."
+    echo "  Install from https://www.python.org/downloads/ or via Homebrew:"
+    echo "  brew install python@3.12"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# uv
+if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "ERROR: uv is not installed."
+    echo "  Install uv: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# ngrok
+if ! command -v ngrok >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "ERROR: ngrok is not installed."
+    echo "  Install ngrok: brew install ngrok/ngrok/ngrok"
+    echo "  OR download from: https://ngrok.com/download"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Port 8000
+if lsof -ti:8000 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    PID_ON_PORT=$(lsof -ti:8000)
+    echo "ERROR: Port 8000 is already in use by PID ${PID_ON_PORT}."
+    echo "  Run: kill ${PID_ON_PORT}   then retry."
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Optional .env file
+if [ -f .env ]; then
+    # shellcheck disable=SC1091
+    source .env
+fi
+if [ -z "${WEB_AUTH_USER:-}" ]; then
+    echo "WARNING: WEB_AUTH_USER not set — server will start without authentication."
+fi
+
+# ── Install Python dependencies ────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+echo "Installing dependencies..."
+uv sync --quiet 2>/dev/null || pip install -e . -q
+
+# ── Start FastAPI server in background ────────────────────────────────────────
+
+echo "Starting FastAPI server on http://127.0.0.1:8000 ..."
+uv run uvicorn webapp.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 &
+SERVER_PID=$!
+
+# Wait up to 5 s for port 8000 to accept connections
+READY=0
+for i in $(seq 1 10); do
+    if nc -z 127.0.0.1 8000 2>/dev/null; then
+        READY=1
+        break
+    fi
+    sleep 0.5
+done
+
+if [ "$READY" -eq 0 ]; then
+    echo "ERROR: FastAPI server did not start within 5 seconds."
+    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# ── Start ngrok tunnel in background ──────────────────────────────────────────
+
+echo "Starting ngrok tunnel..."
+ngrok http 8000 --log=stdout >/tmp/ngrok.log 2>&1 &
+NGROK_PID=$!
+
+# Poll ngrok local API for the public URL (up to 10 s)
+PUBLIC_URL=""
+for i in $(seq 1 20); do
+    PUBLIC_URL=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels 2>/dev/null \
+        | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['tunnels'][0]['public_url'])" \
+        2>/dev/null || true)
+    if [ -n "$PUBLIC_URL" ]; then
+        break
+    fi
+    sleep 0.5
+done
+
+if [ -z "$PUBLIC_URL" ]; then
+    echo "ERROR: ngrok tunnel did not start. Check /tmp/ngrok.log for details."
+    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+    kill "$NGROK_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# ── Print success ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+echo ""
+echo "✅  Server: http://127.0.0.1:8000"
+echo "🌐  Public: ${PUBLIC_URL}"
+echo "📱  Open the public URL on your iPhone, then tap Share → Add to Home Screen"
+echo ""
+echo "Press Ctrl-C to stop."
+
+# ── Trap SIGINT for clean shutdown ────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+trap 'echo ""; echo "Stopping..."; kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; kill "$NGROK_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 0' INT
+
+# Keep script alive until Ctrl-C
+wait "$SERVER_PID"

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Morning runner — orchestrates the daily trade pipeline.
+
+Steps:
+1. Download latest OHLCV data via fetch_history
+2. Optionally retrain the GBM model based on --retrain schedule
+3. Run prediction → write next_alloc.csv
+4. Run Robinhood executor (dry-run by default)
+
+Usage examples:
+    uv run morning-runner --tickers_file tickers/sp500.txt
+    uv run morning-runner --tickers AAPL,MSFT,NVDA --retrain weekly
+    uv run morning-runner --tickers_file tickers/sp500.txt --no_dry_run
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import glob
+import logging
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+from datetime import date, datetime
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+import joblib
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+# ── project imports ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+from paper_trading_sim import (
+    build_feature_panel,
+    build_features,
+    fetch_history,
+    prepare_xy,
+    train_model,
+)
+from predict_next import (
+    compute_returns,
+    fetch_latest_frames,
+    meanvar_long_only,
+    parse_tickers,
+)
+
+
+# ── logging setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def setup_logging(log_dir: str) -> None:
+    """Configure logging to both console and a dated file in log_dir."""
+    os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
+    log_file = os.path.join(log_dir, f"morning_{date_str}.log")
+
+    fmt = "%(asctime)s  %(levelname)-8s  %(message)s"
+    logging.basicConfig(
+        level=logging.INFO,
+        format=fmt,
+        handlers=[
+            logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout),
+            logging.FileHandler(log_file),
+        ],
+    )
+    logging.getLogger(__name__).info("Logging to %s", log_file)
+
+
+# ── model helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def find_latest_model(models_dir: str = "models") -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return path to the most recently modified .joblib file, or None."""
+    bundles = glob.glob(os.path.join(models_dir, "*.joblib"))
+    if not bundles:
+        return None
+    return max(bundles, key=os.path.getmtime)
+
+
+def should_retrain(retrain: str, latest_model: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+    """Return True if the pipeline should retrain the model now."""
+    if retrain == "never":
+        return False
+    if latest_model is None:
+        return True  # no existing model — must train
+    age_days = (datetime.now().timestamp() - os.path.getmtime(latest_model)) / 86400.0
+    if retrain == "weekly":
+        return age_days >= 7
+    if retrain == "monthly":
+        return age_days >= 30
+    return False
+
+
+# ── pipeline steps ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def step_retrain(tickers: List[str], models_dir: str = "models") -> str:
+    """Retrain GBM on 5 years of data and save bundle to models/.
+
+    Returns:
+        Absolute path to the saved .joblib bundle.
+    """
+    log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+    log.info("Retraining model on %d tickers ...", len(tickers))
+
+    start = date.today().replace(year=date.today().year - 5).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
+    end = date.today().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
+
+    raw = fetch_history(tickers, start=start, end=end)
+    if not raw:
+        raise RuntimeError("fetch_history returned no data -- cannot retrain")
+
+    feats = build_feature_panel(raw)
+    feats = {t: f for t, f in feats.items() if not f.empty}
+    if not feats:
+        raise RuntimeError("No feature frames to retrain on")
+
+    frames = []
+    for t, f in feats.items():
+        f2 = f.copy()
+        f2["ticker"] = t
+        frames.append(f2)
+    panel = pd.concat(frames).dropna()
+
+    X, y, feat_cols = prepare_xy(panel)
+    model = train_model(X, y)
+
+    os.makedirs(models_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
+    out_path = os.path.join(models_dir, f"model_bundle_{date_str}.joblib")
+    joblib.dump({"model": model, "features": feat_cols}, out_path)
+    log.info("Saved retrained model -> %s", out_path)
+    return out_path
+
+
+def step_predict(
+    tickers: List[str],
+    model_path: str,
+    alloc_csv: str,
+    top_n: int = 5,
+    period: str = "2y",
+    cov_lookback: int = 90,
+    shrink: float = 0.2,
+    max_w: float = 0.3,
+    capital: float = 100_000.0,
+) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    """Run next-day GBM prediction and mean-variance allocation.
+
+    Writes the allocation to alloc_csv and returns the DataFrame.
+    Returns an empty DataFrame if no predictions could be produced.
+    """
+    log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+    log.info("Loading model bundle from %s", model_path)
+
+    bundle = joblib.load(model_path)
+    model = bundle["model"]
+    feat_cols: List[str] = bundle["features"]
+
+    log.info("Fetching latest price data for %d tickers ...", len(tickers))
+    raw = fetch_latest_frames(tickers, period=period)
+
+    rows = []
+    for t, df in raw.items():
+        feats = build_features(df).dropna()
+        if feats.empty:
+            continue
+        if any(c not in feats.columns for c in feat_cols):
+            continue
+        latest = feats.iloc[-1]
+        X = latest[feat_cols].astype(float).values.reshape(1, -1)
+        pred = float(model.predict(X)[0])
+        rows.append({"date": latest.name, "ticker": t, "pred": pred})
+
+    pred_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
+    if pred_df.empty:
+        log.warning("No predictions produced -- check data or feature alignment")
+        return pd.DataFrame()
+
+    pred_df = pred_df.sort_values(["date", "pred"], ascending=[True, False])
+    last_date = pred_df["date"].max()
+    today_preds = pred_df[pred_df["date"] == last_date].sort_values("pred", ascending=False)
+    top = today_preds.head(top_n)
+
+    log.info("Predictions for %s: top %d", last_date, len(top))
+    for _, r in top.iterrows():
+        log.info("  %-6s  pred_fwd_ret_1d=%+.4f", r["ticker"], r["pred"])
+
+    # ── mean-variance allocation ───────────────────────────────────────────────
+    universe = top["ticker"].tolist()
+    ret_panel = compute_returns(
+        {t: raw[t] for t in universe if t in raw}, lookback=cov_lookback
+    )
+
+    if ret_panel.empty or ret_panel.shape[1] < 2:
+        w = np.ones(len(universe)) / max(1, len(universe))
+        Sigma = np.diag(np.ones(len(universe)) * 1e-4)
+    else:
+        Sigma_emp = ret_panel.cov().to_numpy()
+        lam = min(max(shrink, 0.0), 1.0)
+        diag = np.diag(np.diag(Sigma_emp))
+        Sigma = (1 - lam) * Sigma_emp + lam * diag
+        mu_map = {r.ticker: r.pred for _, r in top.iterrows()}
+        mu = np.array([mu_map[t] for t in universe])
+        w = meanvar_long_only(mu, Sigma, max_w=max_w)
+
+    closes = {
+        t: float(raw[t]["Close"].iloc[-1])
+        if (t in raw and "Close" in raw[t].columns)
+        else float("nan")
+        for t in universe
+    }
+    alloc = pd.DataFrame({"ticker": universe, "weight": w})
+    alloc["dollars"] = alloc["weight"] * capital
+    alloc["close"] = alloc["ticker"].map(closes)
+    alloc["shares"] = (alloc["dollars"] / alloc["close"]).fillna(0.0)
+
+    mu_vec = np.array([float(top[top["ticker"] == t]["pred"].iloc[0]) for t in universe])
+    port_mu = float(w @ mu_vec)
+    port_sigma = float(np.sqrt(w @ (Sigma @ w))) if len(universe) > 0 else 0.0
+
+    log.info("Suggested allocation (long-only, capped):")
+    for _, r in alloc.sort_values("weight", ascending=False).iterrows():
+        log.info("  %-6s  %.2f%%  ($%.0f)", r["ticker"], r["weight"] * 100, r["dollars"])
+    log.info(
+        "Est. next-day return: %+.2f%%  Est. daily vol: %.2f%%",
+        port_mu * 100,
+        port_sigma * 100,
+    )
+
+    alloc.to_csv(alloc_csv, index=False)
+    log.info("Saved allocation -> %s", alloc_csv)
+    return alloc
+
+
+def step_execute(alloc_csv: str, dry_run: bool = True) -> None:

+
+DOJI_THRESHOLD = 0.0005
+
+
+def _is_doji(bar: pd.Series) -> bool:
+    return abs(bar["Close"] - bar["Open"]) < DOJI_THRESHOLD * bar["Close"]
+
+
+class EngulfingStrategy(BaseStrategy):
+    def generate_signal(self, prev: pd.Series, curr: pd.Series, bar_index: int = 0) -> Signal:
+        if _is_doji(prev) or _is_doji(curr):
+            return Signal("HOLD", curr["Close"], bar_index)
+
+        prev_red = prev["Open"] > prev["Close"]
+        curr_green = curr["Close"] > curr["Open"]
+
+        if prev_red and curr_green:
+            if curr["Open"] <= prev["Close"] and curr["Close"] >= prev["Open"]:
+                return Signal("BUY", curr["Close"], bar_index)
+
+        prev_green = prev["Open"] < prev["Close"]
+        curr_red = curr["Close"] < curr["Open"]
+

+            if curr["Open"] >= prev["Close"] and curr["Close"] <= prev["Open"]:
+                return Signal("SELL", curr["Close"], bar_index)
+

+import numpy as np

+

+
+
+def _simple_sigma(n: int = 3) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Return a simple diagonal covariance matrix."""
+    return np.diag([0.01, 0.01, 0.01][:n])
+
+
+# mu vector where the raw Σ^{-1}μ weights (proportional to mu for diagonal Σ)
+# sum to a positive number so no fallback is triggered, yet one entry is negative.
+# Chosen so sum(mu) > 0: 0.08 + (-0.02) + 0.03 = 0.09
+_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE = np.array([0.08, -0.02, 0.03])
+
+
+class TestMeanvarLongOnly:
+    def test_all_weights_nonneg_with_negative_mu(self):
+        """Long-only should clip negatives; all weights >= 0 even when mu has a negative entry."""
+        w = meanvar_long_only(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert np.all(w >= 0.0), f"Expected all weights >= 0, got {w}"
+
+    def test_negative_mu_asset_gets_zero_weight(self):
+        """The asset with negative mu must receive exactly 0 weight (clamped)."""
+        w = meanvar_long_only(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert w[1] == 0.0, f"Negative-mu asset must be clamped to 0, got w[1]={w[1]}"
+
+    def test_weights_sum_to_one(self):
+        mu = np.array([0.05, 0.03, 0.02])
+        w = meanvar_long_only(mu, _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert abs(w.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-9, f"Weights should sum to 1, got {w.sum()}"
+
+    def test_all_negative_mu_falls_back_to_equal(self):
+        """When all predicted returns are negative the fallback produces equal weights."""
+        mu = np.array([-0.05, -0.03, -0.02])
+        w = meanvar_long_only(mu, _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert np.all(w >= 0.0)
+        assert abs(w.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-9
+
+    def test_max_w_cap_respected(self):
+        """The per-asset cap must be enforced."""
+        # Use a dominant asset that would exceed the cap without clamping.
+        # With diagonal Sigma raw weights ∝ mu; 0.5/(0.5+0.1+0.1)≈0.71 > 0.5 cap.
+        mu = np.array([0.50, 0.10, 0.10])
+        w = meanvar_long_only(mu, _simple_sigma(3), max_w=0.5)
+        assert np.all(w <= 0.5 + 1e-9), f"Max weight violated: {w}"
+
+
+class TestMeanvarLongShort:
+    def test_negative_mu_produces_negative_weight(self):
+        """When one asset has a negative predicted return, its weight should be negative."""
+        w = meanvar_long_short(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert w[1] < 0.0, f"Expected negative weight for negative-mu entry, got {w}"
+
+    def test_long_only_same_mu_all_nonneg(self):
+        """Confirm long-only variant gives >= 0 for the same input where long-short gives negative."""
+        w_lo = meanvar_long_only(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert np.all(w_lo >= 0.0), f"Long-only should produce no negatives, got {w_lo}"
+
+    def test_weights_sum_to_one(self):
+        w = meanvar_long_short(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert abs(w.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-9, f"Weights should sum to 1, got {w.sum()}"
+
+    def test_positive_mu_all_weights_nonneg(self):
+        """With all positive mu both allocators should give all positive weights."""
+        mu = np.array([0.05, 0.03, 0.02])
+        w_ls = meanvar_long_short(mu, _simple_sigma(3))
+        assert np.all(w_ls >= 0.0), f"All-positive mu should give non-negative weights, got {w_ls}"
+
+    def test_meanvar_long_only_not_modified(self):
+        """Regression guard: meanvar_long_only must still clamp negative raw weights to 0."""
+        w_lo = meanvar_long_only(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))
+        w_ls = meanvar_long_short(_MU_WITH_NEGATIVE.copy(), _simple_sigma(3))

        end_inclusive = (pd.Timestamp(end) + pd.Timedelta(days=1)).date()

            alts = [sym]
            if "." in sym:
                alts.append(sym.replace(".", "-"))
            if "-" in sym:
                alts.append(sym.replace("-", "."))
            seen = set()
            ordered = []
            for s in alts:
                if s not in seen:
                    seen.add(s)
                    ordered.append(s)
            return ordered

        BATCH = 50
        for i in range(0, len(tickers), BATCH):
            batch = tickers[i : i + BATCH]
            df = None
            try:
                df = yf.download(
                    batch,
                    start=start,
                    end=end_inclusive,
                    interval="1d",
                    group_by="ticker",
                    auto_adjust=True,
                    threads=True,
                    progress=False,
                )
            except Exception:
                df = None
            if df is None:
                for t in batch:
                    single = None
                    for sym in alt_symbols(t):
                        try:
                            tmp = yf.download(sym, start=start, end=end_inclusive, interval="1d", auto_adjust=True, progress=False)
                            if isinstance(tmp, pd.DataFrame) and not tmp.empty:
                                single = tmp
                                break
                        except Exception:
                            continue
                    if single is not None and not single.empty:
                        single.to_csv(Path(out_dir) / f"{t}.csv")
                        saved += 1
                    else:
                        failures.append(t)
            else:
                if isinstance(df.columns, pd.MultiIndex):
                    for t in batch:
                        if t in df:
                            sub = df[t].dropna()
                            if not sub.empty:
                                sub.to_csv(Path(out_dir) / f"{t}.csv")
                                saved += 1
                            else:
                                failures.append(t)
                        else:
                            failures.append(t)
                else:
                    t = batch[0]
                    if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) and not df.empty:
                        df.to_csv(Path(out_dir) / f"{t}.csv")
                        saved += 1
                    else:
                        failures.append(t)
        return {"saved": saved, "failures": failures, "out_dir": out_dir}

    message = None
    error = None
    result = None
    try:
        result = await run_in_threadpool(_task)
        msg = f"Saved {result['saved']} CSV files to {result['out_dir']}."
        if result["failures"]:
            msg += f" Failed: {', '.join(result['failures'][:10])}"
        message = msg
    except Exception as exc:
